title: Staff Software Engineer, Financial Platform - Issuing

desc: It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible. Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy. The Role At Block, we strive to build the best financial products in the world. The Financial Platform Issuing team owns the card issuing platform that serves every Block brand — powering Cash App Card, the fourth-largest debit card program in the US, alongside Square Card and the new card programs Block launches next. We run the full lifecycle of a card: issuance, fulfillment, and activation; real-time transaction authorization and processing across card networks; digital wallet provisioning; 3-D Secure authentication; clearing and settlement; and disputes. When a customer taps their card at a register, our systems decide the outcome in milliseconds, around the clock, in partnership with card networks and bank partners. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Issuing server engineering team, you will bring deep card-network expertise to some of the most complex technical work on our roadmap. You will work alongside technical leads and cross functional teams, going deep where our platform meets the networks: specifications, protocols, certification, mandates, conformance, and production behavior. This is a hands-on role. You will build systems and tooling, debug at the message level, and turn your network expertise into durable capabilities that other engineers can use. You will also work directly with the networks themselves — not only understanding what they require, but knowing where and how to influence outcomes for Block. You Will Be a deep technical expert on global card networks, helping Issuing teams interpret network specifications, message flows, certification requirements, mandates, and production behavior — and working directly with the networks to influence requirements, resolve ambiguity, and secure outcomes that matter for Block. Lead complex, ambiguous engineering problems at the network boundary that span multiple teams, systems, or domains. Partner with technical leads, program DRIs, and senior stakeholders to shape solutions where card-network requirements intersect with Block's issuing platform. Stay deeply hands-on: write production code, build certification and conformance tooling, analyze network messages, review designs and code, and debug issues down to the protocol and field level. Drive network certification and mandatory release cycles end to end, and translate network requirements into clear, pragmatic engineering decisions. Establish shared frameworks, standards, tooling, and practices that make network expertise durable and enable teams to operate independently. Raise the technical capability of engineers around you through design guidance, code reviews, mentorship, documentation, and clear technical judgment. Apply AI-powered tools throughout the engineering lifecycle to improve velocity and quality, and help establish effective patterns for broader team use. Share operational ownership of critical financial systems through on-call, incident response, and continuous improvements to reliability and correctness. title: Senior Manager – Software Engineering (REF# ME0826)
desc: Job Duties: Manage and oversee complex software development initiatives, coordinating multiple development efforts supporting web services, software deployment, and partner framework integrations. Establish project objectives, technical policies, procedures, roadmaps, and work plans, and delegate tasks to project team members. Lead Agile sprint teams in planning, prioritizing, and delivering software features in alignment with project requirements and organizational goals. Oversee system and software architecture development, system requirements, and technical design activities. Direct modernization efforts for transaction monitoring and sanction screening systems by designing and implementing models and standardized procedures for high-volume payment, AML, and foreign exchange operations. Evaluate, adapt, and define methods and procedures for new project assignments, ensuring effective execution across teams. Contribute to full-cycle web application and middleware development, including requirement analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance. Oversee database data retrieval strategies and develop data migration plans to support system upgrades and integrations. Position allows 100% remote work from anywhere in the U.S. and reports to Convera’s HQ. Job Requirements: This position requires a bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Applications or related field plus 8 years of experience in any related occupation. The employer will accept a Master’s Degree plus 6 years of experience in any related occupation in lieu of a Bachelor’s Degree plus 8 years. In addition, must have some experience in each of the following skills: Project planning tools such as Smart Sheet; Database design using SQL and NoSQL; SQL Server and Oracle databases; C#, .Net core; ETL tools such as SSIS, Informatica, or Talend; Analytics tools such as Business Object, QlikView, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS); Test-driven development and CI/CD software engineering practices; Waterfall, SCRUM, and Agile-based methodologies, practices and tools; Software development life-cycle tools such as Jira and Confluence; Code version control systems such as GIT or SVN. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.
